events.evidence: The United States sends aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt and cruiser USS Normandy to block an Iranian convoy heading towards Yemen
Blue Bell Creameries recalls all of its products in the United States due to a Listeria monocytogenes outbreak
Police officers in the city of Baltimore, Maryland are placed on leave while an investigation is held into the death of Freddie Gray

label.note: US-Iran/Yemen tension, recalls and Baltimore unrest tilt risk appetite lower.
